epinastic.definition:
a. A term applied to that phase of vegetable growth in
   which an organ grows more rapidly on its upper than on its under
   surface. See Hyponastic.

epineural.definition: a. Arising from the neurapophysis of a vertebra.

epineurium.definition:
n. The connective tissue framework and sheath of a nerve
   which bind together the nerve bundles, each of which has its own
   special sheath, or perineurium.
